dataList.name: The Nascent Crimson God
dataList.desc:
Когда this unit gains [Charge:*Соли*], gains [ChargeRouge] вместо этого

Начало битвы: Получает 1 силы [ChargeRouge]

Начало хода: При 2+ силы [ChargeRouge], получает +(силы [ChargeRouge] x 2) счётчика [ChargeRouge]
dataList.flavor: A young god, but a god nonetheless.

dataList.name: Pulsating Nature
dataList.desc: получает +1 счётчик [ChargeRouge] every time [Laceration:*Кетчупа*] effect is activated in an Encounter
dataList.flavor: Why... does blood make my heart rush so excitedly?

dataList.name: The Adventure
dataList.desc:
Получает следующие эффекты, основываясь на силы [ChargeRouge] на себе
- 1+: за каждые счётчика [ChargeRouge], наносит +2% урона и хилит +10% ХП на цели (макс. 20%, 100% respectively; округляется вниз)
- 2+: Базовая сила +1 за каждые 2 силы [ChargeRouge] на себе
- 3+: Начало хода: Если this unit не have [GourmandiseAlly], и Если у этого юнита есть 15+ счётчика [ChargeRouge], тратит весь счётчик [ChargeRouge] и получает 3 [GourmandiseAlly]
- 4+: Skill Slot +1
- 5+: Начало битвы: Получает 3 [GourmandiseAlly] и наносит 3 [BloodyMucusAlly] на всех врагов
dataList.summary: Effect enhanced based on силы [ChargeRouge] на себе
dataList.flavor: With every step they получает, toddling from behind their first guardians, the child learns about the world, about the department store... и themself.

dataList.name: A Helping Hand
dataList.desc: Когда an ally is Staggered during an Encounter, использует "Grab My Hand" on the said ally (2 раз за ход)

dataList.name: Body Out of Control
dataList.desc:
Если у этого юнита есть [GourmandiseAlly], получает следующие эффекты:
- Хилит ХП равный 20% of урона dealt
- при использовании скилла, получает +3 счётчика [Laceration:*Кетчупа*]
- При ударе using a Skill, получает 1 [Laceration:*Кетчупа*]
dataList.flavor: Though the arms, legs, и everything else about their body feels alien to the child, the faint beating from their core will soon begin its mad pulsation.

dataList.name: Leather-sewing Nail
dataList.desc: Когда this unit fails to defeat an enemy using its Attack Skills, использует "I'll End It for You..." on the said enemy (один раз за ход)
dataList.flavor: They said I needed a thick, sturdy nail to punch through leather for sewing. Если that didn't work, I just need to try again...!

dataList.name: Le Visqueux-Abject
dataList.desc:
This unit takes урона only от скиллов mainly targeting this unit, и it takes no other урона

При первом выходе на поле боя, generate [BuffetField] on the field

Начало хода: Targets within the [BuffetField] Получает следующие эффекты:
- Allies (including this unit)
  · Хилит 5% ХП
  · получает +4 счётчика [Charge:*Соли*]
  · Получает 1 [Protection]
  · Если the affected ally is a "Le Rouge" unit, получает 2 [Enhancement]
  · Э.Г.О Skills наносит +50% урона

- Enemies
  · Получает 3 [AttackDown]
  · Получает 3 [DefenseDown]
  · Получает 2 [BloodyMucusAlly]
dataList.flavor:
In an endless feast, the Crimson God consumes и consumes; what is devoured is then digested и excreted as a field of mucus around them.
This is the outcome of consumption, where the distinction between self и other blurs. Is this phlegmatic discharge a part of me, или is it of another? Within this boundary, все that is mine pulsates, while все that is not disintegrates.

For I am afraid of what lies outside the periphery.

dataList.name: La Fin de l'Enfance
dataList.desc:
Начало битвы: Получает 5 силы [ChargeRouge]

Конец хода: При 15+ счётчика [ChargeRouge], equip "La Nausée" Skill
Every Начало хода: получает +20 [Aggro]
dataList.flavor:
Who determines the childhood's end?

The crimson child matured throughout the adventure, shaped на their experiences и sketching their own future при the end of the journey—или so they thought. Their childhood came to a sudden halt, и so too did the adventure; it was never something they could've ended on their own terms.

Childhood's end is a sudden, violent intrusion of reality from the world outside, more a forceful notice than a promised ritual: "You're not a child anymore."
